app.title.description: Main app name displayed on the home screen.
app.title.notes: Do not translate the app name.

app.subtitle.description: Prompt below the title directing users to pick a game.

nav.back.notes: Keep short. The arrow ← may be kept or replaced with the locale's equivalent.

nav.backLabel.description: Accessibility label for the back button.

theme.label.description: Row label next to the theme mode selector.

theme.light.description: Theme toggle button text for switching to light mode.

theme.dark.description: Theme toggle button text for switching to dark mode.

theme.system.description: Segmented-control option that follows the OS light/dark preference.
theme.system.notes: Short — fits a compact 3-way segmented control alongside 'Light' and 'Dark'.

theme.switchTo.description: Accessibility label for the theme toggle. {{mode}} is 'light' or 'dark'.
theme.switchTo.notes: {{mode}} will already be translated by the time it is interpolated.

theme.lightShort.description: Short version of 'Light mode' for compact header buttons.

theme.darkShort.description: Short version of 'Dark mode' for compact header buttons.

lang.switcherLabel.description: Accessibility label for the language selector control.

network.offlineBanner.description: Banner shown app-wide when the device is offline, explaining that scores will sync later.

a11y.loading.description: Screen-reader label for the loading spinner shown while a screen fetches data. Not shown visually.
a11y.loading.notes: Spoken by VoiceOver and TalkBack. Use the short progressive form, e.g. 'Loading'.

brand.wordmark.description: Compact app wordmark intended for use in screen headers.
brand.wordmark.notes: Currently unused in the app; do not translate the app name.

nav.lobby.description: Bottom tab bar label for the games lobby/home tab.

nav.profile.description: Bottom tab bar label for the profile tab.

nav.settings.description: Bottom tab bar label for the settings tab; also reused as the Settings screen's header title.

newGame.button.description: Button label to start a new game from within an active game.

newGame.confirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before starting a new game.

newGame.confirm.body.description: Body text of the new-game confirmation dialog, warning that current progress will be lost.

newGame.confirm.confirm.description: Confirm button label on the new-game confirmation dialog.

newGame.confirm.cancel.description: Cancel button label on the new-game confirmation dialog; also the default cancel label for the shared ConfirmModal component.

settings.soundEffects.description: Label for the global sound effects toggle in Settings.

clearLogs.label.description: Row label in Settings for clearing locally queued logs and events.

clearLogs.description.description: Explanatory text under the Clear local logs row in Settings.

clearLogs.button.description: Button label to clear local logs in Settings.

clearLogs.confirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before clearing local logs.

clearLogs.confirm.body.description: Body text of the clear-logs confirmation dialog, warning the action can't be undone.

clearLogs.confirm.confirm.description: Confirm button label on the clear-logs confirmation dialog.

clearLogs.confirm.cancel.description: Cancel button label on the clear-logs confirmation dialog.

clearLogs.success.description: Success message shown after local logs are cleared.

capacityWarning.title.description: Title of the toast warning that queued offline game data is filling local storage.

capacityWarning.body.description: Body text of the capacity warning toast, directing the player to Settings.

capacityWarning.dismiss.description: Button and accessibility label to dismiss the capacity warning toast.

deck.label.description: Row label in Settings for the card deck (skin) picker.

deck.select.description: Accessibility label for a selectable card deck option in Settings.

deck.selected.description: Accessibility label for the currently selected card deck option in Settings.

overflow.menu.label.description: Accessibility label for the overflow (⋯) menu button.

overflow.menu.scorecard.description: Overflow menu item that opens the live scorecard of the match in progress: the Hearts rounds table, the Yacht scorecard or the Blackjack session. Also that screen's title. Not the player's history (that is the Stats item).

scorecard.unavailable.description: Shown on the Scorecard screen if it is opened for a game with no live scorecard.

overflow.menu.stats.description: Overflow menu item that opens the player's stats for this game.

overflow.menu.leaderboard.description: Overflow menu item that opens the game's leaderboard.

overflow.menu.newGame.description: Overflow menu item that starts a new game.

overflow.menu.levelSelect.description: Overflow menu item that opens level/difficulty selection.

overflow.menu.editNames.description: Overflow menu item that opens player name editing.

overflow.abandon.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before abandoning the current game from the overflow menu.

overflow.abandon.body.description: Body text of the abandon-game confirmation dialog, clarifying that lifetime stats are unaffected.

overflow.abandon.keepPlaying.description: Cancel button label on the abandon-game confirmation dialog.

overflow.abandon.startNew.description: Confirm button label on the abandon-game confirmation dialog.

home.locked.buttonLabel.description: Button label on a locked, coming-soon game card on the home screen.

home.locked.cardLabel.description: Accessibility label for a locked, coming-soon game card on the home screen.

home.locked.comingSoon.description: Alert message shown when tapping a locked, coming-soon game card.

deleteData.label.description: Row label in Settings for permanently deleting the player's data.

deleteData.description.description: Explanatory text under the Delete my data row in Settings.

deleteData.button.description: Button label to delete the player's data in Settings.

deleteData.confirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before deleting the player's data.

deleteData.confirm.body.description: Body text of the delete-data confirmation dialog, warning the action is permanent and irreversible.

deleteData.confirm.confirm.description: Confirm button label on the delete-data confirmation dialog.

deleteData.confirm.cancel.description: Cancel button label on the delete-data confirmation dialog.

deleteData.success.description: Success message shown after the player's data is deleted.

deleteData.error.description: Error message shown when deleting the player's data fails.

level.pill.description: Compact Arcade level badge in the Home header, e.g. 'Lv 4'. Abbreviate 'level' the way games in this language usually do.
level.pill.notes: Must stay very short — it sits in the header next to the title. Renders as e.g. 'Niv. 4' (under 8 characters); the limit counts the raw {{level}}.

level.pillA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Arcade level badge in the Home header.

streak.pill.description: Compact daily-streak badge in the Home header next to the level pill: a fire emoji and the number of consecutive days, e.g. '🔥 5'.
streak.pill.notes: Keep the emoji and the {{count}} placeholder; it must stay tiny — it shares the header with the title and the level pill. Do not add words.

streak.pillA11y_one.description: Screen-reader label for the streak badge, singular form ({{count}} = 1): the number of consecutive days the player has hit their daily-challenge target.
streak.pillA11y_one.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian).

streak.pillA11y_other.description: Screen-reader label for the streak badge, plural form.
streak.pillA11y_other.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian).

legal.privacyPolicy.description: Link label at the bottom of Settings that opens the Privacy Policy web page in the browser. Use the standard legal term for this document in the target language.
legal.privacyPolicy.notes: Two links share one row — keep it short.

legal.termsOfService.description: Link label at the bottom of Settings that opens the Terms of Service web page in the browser. Use the standard legal term for this document in the target language.
legal.termsOfService.notes: Two links share one row — keep it short.

premiumLevel.title.description: Title of the notice shown when the player taps a difficulty level that is locked because it belongs to the paid tier.
premiumLevel.title.notes: The product name. Keep it exactly as written.

premiumLevel.body.description: Body of the notice shown when the player taps a locked premium difficulty level. The paid tier is not on sale yet.
premiumLevel.body.notes: Say it is coming soon; do not promise a date or tell the player to buy anything.

premiumLevel.ok.description: Button that closes the premium-level notice.

premiumLevel.tag.description: Short tag next to a lock icon on a table card that belongs to the paid tier.

premiumLevel.lockedLabel.description: Screen-reader label for a difficulty option that is locked because it belongs to the paid tier. Not shown visually.
premiumLevel.lockedLabel.notes: {{level}} is the option's own name, e.g. 'Hard'. Spoken by VoiceOver and TalkBack.
